archetypes.name: caller-sweep
archetypes.rationale: Plan removes multiple lib-quiet.sh functions but enumerates callers only by count for larch_quiet_write_paired_pid_file and does not enumerate call sites for the other removed helpers (larch_quiet_bc_valid_category, larch_quiet__exit_write_done, larch_quiet_append_done_trap, larch_quiet_warn_paired_pid_invalid, larch_quiet_source_larch_log_lib, larch_quiet_fd3_is_visible), leaving open the possibility of undefined-function breaks in files outside the reviewer_file_list.
archetypes.prompt_body: For every function name the plan removes from lib-quiet.sh, search the full repository for call sites and cross-reference each hit against the plan's stated change set. Confirm that each call site is either in a file the plan updates, in a file the plan deletes, or in a Stage-4-deferred fence that the shim intentionally keeps working. Flag any call site in a file not mentioned in the plan, and flag any removed function whose callers are described only by count rather than by explicit file paths. Pay particular attention to helper scripts under skills/ subdirectories that source lib-quiet.sh but are not in the reviewer_file_list. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: env-var-scope
archetypes.rationale: Plan removes LARCH_BREADCRUMB_*, LARCH_DONE_SENTINEL, LARCH_STATUS_FILE, LARCH_PAIRED_PID_FILE, and LARCH_BREADCRUMBS_SURFACED_FILE only from the listed scripts, but these env vars may also appear in session-setup scripts, CI helpers, or skill launch wrappers outside the reviewer_file_list that the plan does not mention.
archetypes.prompt_body: Search the repository for every reference to LARCH_BREADCRUMB_STREAM, LARCH_DONE_SENTINEL, LARCH_STATUS_FILE, LARCH_PAIRED_PID_FILE, LARCH_BREADCRUMBS_SURFACED_FILE, and env -u LARCH_ patterns in all shell scripts and Markdown files. For each hit, determine whether the containing file is covered by a plan step, is being deleted, or is a Stage-4-deferred fence that the shim preserves. Flag any reference in a file the plan neither updates nor deletes and that is not an explicitly Stage-4-deferred fence. Also check whether BASH_AUTHORING.md or AGENTS.md directly embeds these var names in prose that the plan does not schedule for editing until Stage 4. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: shard-balance
archetypes.rationale: Plan removes 6 Makefile targets from test-harnesses-16/18/19 and warns of empty-shard risk but provides no concrete before/after membership counts, leaving the test-harness-shards-coverage validation as the only guard against a CI-red mis-balance.
archetypes.prompt_body: Read the Makefile shard definitions for test-harnesses-16, test-harnesses-18, and test-harnesses-19 and identify exactly which of the six deleted targets (test-breadcrumb-monitor, test-breadcrumb-monitor-bash32, test-background-monitor-wait, test-lint-foreground-markers, lint-foreground, lint-foreground-markers) currently live in each shard. Verify that after their removal each remaining shard is non-empty and that no shard ordinal becomes a gap violating the test-harness-shards-coverage check. Also confirm whether the aggregate lint target references lint-foreground-markers by token and whether removing it requires an explicit re-sequencing of subsequent shard numbers that the plan omits. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
